name: The Entrepreneur
overview:
The Entrepreneur follows a young, ambitious entrepreneur who runs Lynx Aerospace, a rapidly growing private space company developing rockets, spacecraft and satellite technology.

While Lynx looks unstoppable from the outside, behind the scenes it’s filled with corporate rivalries, financial problems, launch delays, impossible deadlines and plenty of ridiculous office situations.

As the company grows into a global aerospace giant, its founder must balance business, innovation, employees, investors and his own ambition—all while trying not to accidentally destroy the company he built
